newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Zaire's Mobutu and family to arrive in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu and family to arrive in Morocco.

text.p: Zaire's ousted president Mobutu Sese Seko and his family will arive in the Moroccan capital, Rabat, on Saturday night and stay in a hotel on the Atlantic coast, Moroccan officials told Reuters.
A Reuters correspondent saw an unsual deployment of security forces around the Amphitrite hotel where the ousted dictator will spend his first night.
"The hotel was booked for Mobutu and his family... Therefore it is now not open to the public," a Moroccan official told Reuters.
The hotel is located about 20 km (13 miles) south of Rabat and close to the royal palace of Skhirat where King Hassan of Morocco receives important guests.
